remarks: Welcome to this pristine, light & bright 2 bedroom, 1 bath unit with heat included on a quiet residential street, yet minutes from everything! Step out to the deck off the kitchen to BBQ or relax while enjoying the serene backyard views. 2 large bedrooms with walk-in closets and updated full large bath plus laundry complete the package. 1 reserved parking space in driveway and always plenty of street parking directly in front. Convenient to downtown, walking distance to Table 104 and a quick ride to the Merritt, I-95 & train station! Do not miss this incredible value!
